**Subject Line:** Starting May 8, Our Print Shop Accepts Recycled Paper

**Preheader:** Here's how we're making it easier for artists to print their work sustainably.

**Body:**

Dear Art Community,

Starting from May 8, our print shop will accept recycled paper for printing. This is a significant step towards reducing our environmental impact and promoting sustainable practices.

We encourage all artists to bring a sample of recycled paper to our shop. This will help us ensure we're using the best quality and most eco-friendly materials.

Feel free to bring your own samples or let us know if you need any assistance. We're excited to support artists in making their prints more sustainable.

Thank you for your support and commitment to the environment.

Best regards,
[Your Name]  
Founder, [Your Print Shop Name]
